products.name: blueMonster
products.one_liner: blueMonster lite: the idea-discovery engine for Mac with MBR export, pool sharing, and signed receipt-backed runs.
products.audience: Anyone with a hard question who wants a wide, evidenced search of the space

products.name: Blue
products.one_liner: The verification substrate every MOBLUEHQ product runs on. A private inference mesh that returns sealed, signed results — the scheduler never sees your data, and every answer carries a receipt anyone can verify.
products.audience: Anyone building AI into decisions that carry consequences

products.name: slumberNet
products.one_liner: Pool your computer's spare capacity into the mesh. Install it, and your machine takes on verified AI work in the background, designed to stay out of your way when you're back at it.
products.audience: Anyone with a capable machine and spare capacity to share

products.name: blueMoat
products.one_liner: Screens filings for relevant prior art and ties each quote to its exact place in the source, or refuses to show it.
products.audience: Patent litigation and prosecution teams who need a prior-art first pass they can check line by line
products.not_this: Not a patentability opinion, and not sold or demoed as a tool for drafting or pressing a patent assertion.

products.name: blueAlibi
products.one_liner: Find claims the recorded evidence and tools could not support.
products.audience: Anyone shipping an AI pipeline who needs to know which of its own claims the trace actually backs up
products.not_this: Not a global fact-checker, and not a legal or regulatory opinion.

products.name: blueGlu
products.one_liner: A local-first chat assistant for Mac. Answers on-device by default; you choose when to send a question to a bigger model.
products.audience: Anyone who wants a private, on-device assistant with a frontier model one click away
products.not_this: Not an auto-escalating router today — elevation is a button you press, not something the app decides for you.
